seed_ledger.name: Transwestern Gas Pipeline / Red Chile Lateral
seed_ledger.reason: Still monitor. Re-read the Source NM article of August 17, 2026 in full: it says FERC filings from earlier in 2026 show a planned Red Chile Lateral tied to the Desert Southwest Pipeline Expansion Project, 50 feet from the Green Chile Project (P8290, the Project Jupiter lateral), and that the main project (P7840) is sought in large part to support data centers. It gives no length, endpoints, diameter or capacity for the lateral, and does not say the lateral itself serves a data center, so a length cannot be sourced and it is not queued. It sits beside P8290 and is probably an expansion-docket sibling of it or of P7840; not matched because no source shows it is the same line. Next step: read the FERC docket (PF26-9-000 and the later CP docket) for the lateral length and delivery point. Searches run: 0 new. The web search budget for the session was used up, so no new searches could be run; only direct page reads were done. Checked: Source NM article (loaded, text above); earlier passes found PGJ trade press with no specs, an advocacy letter citing PF26-9-000 that is not neutral, and EIA and state sources not showing the lateral. FERC eLibrary, the state regulator, air permits, county records and developer releases were not re-checked this pass for lack of search.

evidence.note: names the Red Chile Lateral beside Green Chile; no length or endpoints; Desert Southwest project tied to data centers
